summary: User invested funds through Boostyfi in the Aleta token ATLA after prolonged promotion then was unable to claim scheduled vested funds when claim functions stopped working and account information became inaccessible
user_mistake: invested in a promoted token without independently confirming the withdrawal and vesting mechanism
prevention: Verify the token vesting contract and claim mechanism on-chain before investing / Confirm vested tokens can be claimed without relying solely on the Boostyfi interface
